instruction: Configure VLC to allow maximum volume of 150 percent in the interface settings

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC's maximum volume to 150 percent. The evaluator uses the existing check_qt_max_volume function to verify if 'qt-max-volume' in vlcrc is set to '150'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct: getter extracts VLC config file, metric checks 'qt-max-volume' setting, expected value '150' matches instruction requirement
Coverage is complete: evaluator verifies the single requirement (max volume = 150%)
Significant practical issue: Task instruction mentions 'interface settings' implying UI interaction, but evaluator reads vlcrc file which may not be updated until settings are saved/applied
Missing postconfig to ensure VLC saves settings to disk before verification - changes made in UI may not be persisted to config file yet
Risk of false negatives: if agent completes task correctly in UI but VLC hasn't written to vlcrc, evaluator will read stale data and fail
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add postconfig to close VLC gracefully (ensuring settings are saved) or trigger explicit save action before verification
Alternative: Add postconfig command to force VLC to write config to disk (e.g., kill VLC process which triggers config save on most systems)
Consider adding a small delay in postconfig to allow file system to flush changes before getter reads the file
